questions.name: terminal_state
questions.instructions: Which state is this terminal process in, judging from the output tail and process facts? Pick only a listed state.

choices.description: The command is still running and printing progress or logs. Nothing is asked of the person.
The command stopped and waits for a yes or no answer (y/n, [Y/n], confirm, continue?).
The command waits for a password, passphrase, token or other secret.
A pager (less, more, man, a git log or diff view, (END), --More--) holds the terminal and waits for a key.
The output asks for information only the user can give (a choice, a value, a path) that is not a plain yes or no and not a secret.
The command cannot continue and no listed action will fix it (missing tool, permission denied, no network).
